user.title: Montpellier bike counters
user.description: Pick the counters to track. Only counters that published data in the last 7 days are listed, sorted by distance to your home. Each day's total is published the following evening.

data_description.counters: One device and one sensor (last published day total) are created per counter.
data_description.backfill_days: Number of days of daily totals imported into statistics. History is re-read at each start.
